scope: Manufacturer catalogue/website factual descriptions only. No invented suitability or price-tier comparisons. Wizard Graphene,10HGraphene,NARM1 held.

rows.name: Koch Chemie Ceramic Body Cb0.01
rows.summary: A chemically bonded ceramic sealant for painted surfaces, with resistance to acidic and alkaline cleaners, road salt and insect residue.

rows.name: Koch Chemie Ceramic Neo C0.03
rows.summary: A ceramic sealant that adds colour depth and a smooth surface, with protection against bird droppings and road salt.

rows.name: Fireball Nano Coat V3
rows.summary: A ceramic coating for painted surfaces, plastic, wheels, headlights and other exterior parts, with a smooth feel and deep gloss.

rows.name: Fireball Wizard Graphene
rows.note: Maker-only rule: exact Wizard Graphene manufacturer source not established. Retailer claims are not applied.

rows.name: Fireball Devils Blood
rows.summary: A ceramic coating formulated for strong water repellency, using polysilazane and siloxane compounds.

rows.name: Fireball Butterfly
rows.summary: A single-layer ceramic coating formulated for use in changing weather conditions.
rows.note: Current live product is plain Butterfly, not Butterfly Graphene.

rows.name: Fireball Butterfly Graphene
rows.summary: A ceramic coating containing graphene oxides and oils, with more than 80% solids according to Fireball.
rows.note: Distinct sheet identity, not an approved rename of current plain Butterfly.

rows.name: Fireball DOK DO
rows.summary: A two-layer ceramic coating with a hard base layer and a chemical-resistant, glossy top coat.

rows.name: Kovalent Prolong
rows.summary: A ceramic coating using silica and silicon carbide, with resistance to UV exposure, bird droppings and chemicals.

rows.name: Kovalent Revive
rows.summary: A marine ceramic coating for boats, yachts and watercraft, compatible with gel coat, aluminium and clear coat.
rows.note: Marine product. Existing not-an-automotive-warranty restriction retained; no coastal-car suitability recommendation.

rows.name: Kovalent Graphene Matrix
rows.summary: A ceramic coating for glossy paint, with heat-activated repair of minor surface marks at about 100°C.
rows.note: Do not imply normal sunlight reaches the activation temperature or that deep damage heals.

rows.name: Kovalent Borophene
rows.summary: A boron-nitride ceramic coating with silica nanoparticles, heat resistance and protection against oxidation, UV and chemicals.
keyPoints: Single layer up to 10 microns, per maker

rows.name: Kovalent Matte
rows.summary: A ceramic coating made for matte and satin paint, preserving the matte appearance without gloss enhancers.

rows.name: Car Pro CQ.UK 3.0
rows.summary: A ceramic coating with resistance to salt buildup and chemicals, designed for application between 3°C and 40°C.
rows.note: Maker page has conflicting pH3-14 prose versus pH3-13 key features; no exact pH range added to this short copy.

rows.name: Car Pro CQ SiC
rows.summary: A silicon-carbide ceramic coating with a smooth surface, deep gloss and improved resistance to water spotting.
rows.note: Replaces generic CQUARTZ reseller specifications with exact SiC maker claims. Not water-spot proof.

rows.name: Keramik 9H Nano
rows.summary: A 9H-rated ceramic coating described by Keramik as adding gloss and making regular washing easier.

rows.name: Keramik PPC
rows.summary: A two-part clear coating using Base A and Active B, with a wet-look finish and about 20 microns of coating thickness.

rows.name: Keramic 10H Graphene
rows.note: Exact studio 10H Graphene identity not established against maker documentation. Seller Graphene listing does not establish 10H; generic Professional 10H is not equivalent. No substitute technical claims.

rows.name: NAR M1
rows.summary: A matte-finish NAR film listed for owners who want protection without a high-gloss look. Confirm the exact M1 roll and finish with the studio before choosing.
rows.note: Exact M1 secondary listing found; maker current range does not establish M1. Do not confuse M1 with M190. Hold application until studio roll is matched.

rows.name: NAR E190
rows.summary: A glossy, 190-micron paint protection film with heat-activated repair of light surface scratches.

rows.name: NAR M190
rows.summary: A 190-micron paint protection film with a matte or satin appearance and 30-38% gloss according to NAR.
rows.note: Maker page contradicts itself on heat/no-heat repair. No heat-free healing claim in new copy.

rows.name: AVVYX Prime
rows.summary: A clear paint protection film that preserves the original colour and shine, with resistance to scratches, stains, UV and chemicals.
rows.note: Lower price is editorial positioning from current AutoDeck pair, not a durability or impact superiority claim.

rows.name: AVVYX Shield
rows.summary: A clear TPU paint protection film with a glossy, water-repellent surface and self-healing properties.

rows.name: GSWF Ultra lite
rows.summary: A glossy Defender paint protection film with heat-activated repair of fine scratches and a repositionable adhesive.
rows.note: Ultra Lite/Ultra share claims; no invented difference in thickness or impact performance. Price position from current AutoDeck range.

rows.name: GSWF Ultra
rows.summary: A high-gloss Defender paint protection film with heat-activated fine-scratch repair and resistance to water and stains.
rows.note: Middle price position, not an unsupported thicker-film claim. Manufacturer duration statements conflict; no new duration added.

rows.name: GSWF Platinum
rows.summary: A Defender paint protection film with high optical clarity and gloss enhancement, plus heat-activated fine-scratch repair.
keyPoints: Up to 45% gloss enhancement, per maker

rows.name: Cosmo Gold
rows.summary: A glossy TPU paint protection film with a 7.5-mil thickness, self-healing properties and protection against stone chips and stains.

rows.name: Cosmo Platinum
rows.summary: An 8.5-mil, ultra-gloss TPU paint protection film with high tensile strength and resistance to chemicals, UV and yellowing.

rows.name: LLumar Platinum Gloss
rows.summary: A glossy paint protection film with a HydroGard barrier, heat-activated repair of minor scratches and protection against road debris.

rows.name: LLumar Platinum Extra
rows.summary: A thick, clear paint protection film designed for high-impact chip resistance, including track and gravel-road conditions.

rows.name: LLumar Valor
rows.summary: A paint protection film with a Tetrashield ceramic-style topcoat, a high-gloss finish and self-healing properties.

rows.name: Garware Plus
rows.summary: A glossy, clear paint protection film with self-healing properties and resistance to water, stains and chemicals.
rows.note: Price positioning from current AutoDeck range; no invented relative film thickness.

rows.name: Garware Premium
rows.summary: A clear paint protection film with high gloss and optical clarity, self-healing properties and resistance to stains and yellowing.
rows.note: Do not imply a stronger impact rating than Plus from tier name alone.

rows.name: Garware Titanium
rows.summary: A clear paint protection film with high optical clarity, gloss, mechanical strength and an easy-clean surface.
